editorial.description_en: Sky before rain: light, cool, and slightly violet, without the grey that would make it overcast.
editorial.description_ja: 雨のまえの空のような、うすい青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.824, C 0.038, h 252.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 雨 (ame, rain) + 空 (sora, sky), rendaku to -zora. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Rain Sky" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 雨空. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — yuki-kage at ΔE00 4.1, to-yama at ΔE00 4.3, asa-kawa at ΔE00 4.9. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.038 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
